scope: Every function in the recovered Prism 11 in-table function catalogue

notes: Most mathematical functions operate element-wise on columns/variables
Invalid calculations return blank/empty values silently
Blank cells in arithmetic propagate (5 + blank = blank)
Optional parameters use defaults when omitted but must be specified in order
source_metadata.angle_units: Unless otherwise specified, all trigonometric functions use radians

logical.note: Both function and infix syntax work identically

requirements.title: ABS
acceptance: Implement documented argument order, optional defaults, return types, vector/aggregate semantics and domains.
Test supplied examples plus missing values, invalid domains, boundary values and case-insensitive names.
Verify output/blank/error semantics against Prism 11 references; deterministic seeded testing for random functions.
Integrate parser, dependency updates, persistence, undo, row/type changes and import/export.
